concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-002 requires the cleaned dataset to contain ≥ 1000 records after exclusions, but the only primary data source (ADReSS Challenge Dataset) provides fewer than 400 participants in total. This target is unattainable without adding external datasets, which the current scope explicitly excludes (DementiaBank is prohibited). The requirement therefore over‑reaches the defined scope and should be revised to a realistic record count or the scope should be expanded to permit additional data sources.
